panel.title: Modakeke Ifá tapper with ringed point and a single face
panel.summary: A tapper whose pointed tip carries a column of small circles, above a fluted collar, a single face, ring collars, a triangle band and a plain grip. The detections are all bands of the shaft; the face was missed.

register_readings.reading: Fluted collar under the circle-studded point.
Ring collars and the plain grip, boxed several times over.

panel.composition: A single axis: point, face, bands, grip.
panel.narrative: Another tapper from the Modakeke kit. The circles running up the point are worth noting: small repeated marks on a divination tool are the kind of feature that could encode a count, though here they are more likely decoration.
panel.hypotheses: Neutral for 'chronicle'. The circles on the point are a small 'pattern as number' candidate.
uncertainties: Six boxes on four bands; #3 and #4 duplicate #1 and #0.
